name: hook_irq_vector
desc: Hook an IRQ interrupt vector (IRQ 0-7 / INT 08h-0Fh) and save the previous handler
details: Installs a new interrupt handler located at CS:DX into the interrupt vector table for the specified IRQ (IRQ line 0-7, mapping to INT (irq + 8)). Disables interrupts during the vector update, copies the old 4-byte far pointer into [BX] (offset, then segment), and writes the new handler (offset DX, segment CS) into IVT at 0000:(IRQ + 8)*4.

params.name: irq_num
params.desc: IRQ line number (0-7), mapped to INT (irq + 8)

params.name: old_handler_ptr
params.desc: Pointer to 4-byte buffer where the previous far interrupt handler (offset:segment) will be saved

params.name: new_handler_offset
params.desc: Offset in CS of the new interrupt handler routine

0823:0da0.comment: Write new handler offset (DX) into IVT

0823:0d90.comment: Multiply vector number by 4 to get IVT byte offset

0823:0daa.comment: Write new handler segment (CS) into IVT

0823:0da3.comment: Read old handler segment and save to [BX+2]

0823:0d9b.comment: Read old handler offset and save to [BX]
